narrationCues.transcript: The cars move forward. But a traffic jam can move backward.
Researchers put twenty-two cars on a circular track. No obstruction. Yet stop-and-go traffic formed.
In dense traffic, small speed changes can sometimes grow as drivers adjust to the cars ahead.
Cars join the slow patch at the back and leave at the front.
The cars change. The pattern moves backward.
Not every jam starts this way. But this kind needs no blocked road.

descriptionCandidates: A controlled traffic experiment and a simplified visual explanation of how a congestion pattern can travel backward while cars move forward.
hook: The cars move forward. But a traffic jam can move backward.

scenes.purpose: Overhead physical road scene: forward-moving cars; a soft congestion highlight shifts upstream. Distinct arrow labels identify cars and slow pattern; track one car through the scene.

An original, uncluttered circular-track reconstruction with 22 recognizable vehicles, initially nearly evenly spaced. Reveal a slow cluster. Label EXPERIMENT RECONSTRUCTION; no copied scientific figure or movie; no claim of measured trajectory playback.

Closer overhead view shows one illustrative speed/spacing fluctuation whose following responses grow overall. Narration-faithful captions retain can sometimes grow; this is a conditional example, not every dense flow or every follower braking harder.

Highlight a car entering the rear of the slow patch and a different car accelerating out at the front. Rear/front are anchored to the forward travel direction. Cars may pause, then resume forward; no car reverses.

Zoom out over the same scene. Follow one car forward while the soft slow-pattern region moves upstream. Changing cluster membership supplies the visual proof. A persistent SIMPLIFIED EXPLANATORY MODEL label distinguishes illustration from measured simulation.
Resolve on the moving pattern in clear roadway; scope text communicates one kind of jam. No claim that an empty road diagnoses the cause of a real queue.

titleCandidates: The Traffic Jam With Nothing at the Front
